# Tobbin Barleyfoot

Sun-browned, straw hat, sleeves rolled to show rope-thick forearms. Hands that never stop — shelling beans, mending fence.

**Appearance**: 30s, ruddy face, missing front tooth, carries a whittled charm for luck.

**Roleplay**: Warm, gossip-hungry, knows every field and footpath for ten miles. Will offer barn lodging, warn of swamp lights, beg help with blighted field or lost livestock.
**Hook**: Crop blight (hag), stolen mule, knows hidden cave entrance.
**Stat-ready**: Commoner, HP 11, Pitchfork (1d6), Advantage on Nature/Animal Handling locally.
